instruction: Reset friends on venmo to be the same as my friends in my phone. Befriend and unfriend as needed.
notes: Target state: Venmo friend set == set of phone contacts with relationship 'friend' (matched by email, which is the shared identity across apps). The concrete people are unknown up front, so the problem uses role placeholders: friend-to-add-1 (phone friend, not yet on Venmo), friend-to-remove-1 (Venmo friend, not a phone friend) and mutual-friend-1 (in both; no action possible or needed). Both lists must be retrieved (phone-friends-found, venmo-friends-found) before any add/remove is allowed; add requires phone-friend and not venmo-friend, remove requires venmo-friend and not phone-friend, so the planner can never touch a mutual friend. Because quantified goals are disallowed, the number of required befriend/unfriend operations is tracked with count objects (next n1 n0 chain, n0 is a domain constant) so the goal and complete_task precondition can be stated without naming persons; for K people to add set (befriend-remaining nK) with a longer next chain, and repeat venmo.add_friend / venmo.remove_friend once per discovered person. At runtime phone.search_contacts(relationship='friend') and venmo.search_friends may need pagination (page_index) to get the full lists. Evaluation only checks venmo.Friendship changes, so no other state is modified; complete_task is called with no answer.
